model: IN485UNI001I100 (universal IR air conditioner gateway, BACnet MS/TP)
equipment_type: Split air conditioner BACnet gateway (1 IR-controlled indoor unit)
applies_to: Any indoor unit (split, ductless, cassette) that takes commands from an infrared remote control.
summary: One-unit Intesis gateway that drives an air conditioner by infrared, the same way its handheld remote does, and exposes it on BACnet MS/TP as 33 fixed objects plus the Device object. Each function has a _command object to write and a _status object to read. Because IR is one-way, the status objects show what the gateway sent or picked up from the IR remote, not a reading from the unit's own controller. The gateway also has its own humidity sensor and a set of start-up value objects.
notes: Object names are as printed in each object's Object_Name property. RGB_Led_Intesity is spelled that way in the manual; the summary table spells SetPoint_startup with a capital P.
Fan speeds, modes and vane positions available depend on the AC unit's IR code set.

The manual's tables give the start-up fan speed and vane objects, Setpoint_startup and ResetBehaviour as read-only on BACnet, while the matching Modbus registers are read/write. Access is shown as printed.
Setpoint and room temperature are in °C or °F (the Units property shows which).

source.title: IN485UNI001I100 Universal Gateway - Integration of IR-Enabled Indoor Units into BACnet MS/TP and Modbus RTU - User Manual

integration.summary: Mount the gateway where its IR transmitter reaches the indoor unit, wire it to the MS/TP bus and configure it with Intesis MAPS. Then write the _command objects for on/off, mode, setpoint, fan and vanes and read the _status objects back. One gateway serves one indoor unit.

minimum_points.name: OnOff_status
minimum_points.why: On/off state the gateway holds for the unit

integration.enable: No enable point is documented; commands go out by IR as soon as they are written. BV 2 LockRemoteControl can lock out the handheld IR remote.
setup: Default device instance 246000; the Device object's Object_Name and Description are writable.
Protocol (BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU) and addressing are configured with the Intesis MAPS tool; the gateway can also auto-learn the AC model from its IR remote.
A 3-position DIP switch inside the enclosure sets the EIA-485 termination resistor and bus polarization.
Place the gateway in line of sight of the indoor unit's IR receiver; Parrot mode (3 button clicks, or BV 3) repeats a learned IR command to test the location.
gotchas: IR is one-way: status objects show the state the gateway sent or saw from the IR remote, not feedback from the unit.
ResetBehaviour (MV 4) decides whether the last on/off, mode, fan, vane and setpoint values are stored and resent after a gateway reset.
Leave ParrotMode (BV 3) off in normal use; it re-sends one IR command every second.
